ModMetaData.name: Ordered Work (Core)
ModMetaData.author: nightmare123487
ModMetaData.description: Work Control (0.3.0-alpha.6). Adds a full-screen "Work Control" bottom tab laid out like the vanilla Work tab: one row per free colonist, a fixed pawn name column and a shared horizontal lane of flat single-line WorkType cards, with one outer vertical scroll. Cards are ~190x30 and show one line in a fixed order: passion icon, best skill level, WorkType name (ellipsized, full name in tooltip) and a delete x. When a WorkType has no relevant skill, only the name and delete x are shown. The pawn-name search box matches flexibly against short/full/colored names, title and first/nick/last components, and filters the rows (showing "No pawns match" when empty); it never selects pawns or changes orders. A single click selects a row visually only; a double-click selects the pawn in game (unless already selected) and moves the camera. Draw/Manual/Both view modes and the Open Work tab button are unchanged. Incapable WorkTypes stay out of the lane and stored order; the + picker lists remaining types with levels and shows incapable ones disabled as Incapaz. The colony initializes once at game start; resurrection and new colonists are handled, with capture guards that prevent partial vanilla states from overwriting stored orders. No profiles, schedules or equipment yet. Do not use in a main save; back up your save first.
